en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a large Gothic church with a prominent tower in the foreground, surrounded by a dense cluster of historic rooftops. In the background, a wide river flows through the town, with a multi-arched stone bridge visible crossing it. The opposite riverbank is lined with more buildings and greenery. The text on the postcard reads 'Pirna a.d. Elbe – Blick vom Sonnenstein.'
